topic: Stanislas Dehaene, Jean-Pierre Changeux & Lionel Naccache (2006) Global Neuronal Workspace, 33-ms Masked Subliminal Visual Wave vs 300-ms All-or-None Frontoparietal Ignition, Coma Bedside Detection, and 2025 COGITATE Nature Showdown (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: The 2025 COGITATE Nature multi-lab adversarial collaboration across 256 volunteers testing Dehaene's Global Neuronal Workspace head-to-head against Tononi's Integrated Information Theory.

clips.attire_and_hands: navy knit sweater sleeves and cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly hands extending from the bottom frame edge before a sleek pastel stimulus monitor
clips.prop_action: a brief sky-blue geometric flash appears on the monitor as both cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly hands lift and press the blank-screen response button on a silver keypad
clips.consequence: the pale-slate unseen indicator jewel lights beside the keypad
